title: Quick Roasted Mexican Peanut Tagine
description: A peppery and creamy lacto-vegetarian Mexican dish featuring roasted peanuts, perfect for a brunch mood, made in a tagine pot with a pasta water emulsion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the peanuts in the oven for 10 minutes or until fragrant.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions and reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In the tagine pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped jalapeno pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted peanuts, vegetable broth, and reserved pasta water to the tagine pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and cook until heated through.
